cases.name: occupancy_heat_co2_moisture
cases.requirement: More occupants increase sensible heat, CO2, and moisture.

cases.name: internal_electrical_gains
cases.requirement: Electronics and lighting increase heat and electricity use.

cases.name: outdoor_envelope_direction
cases.requirement: Hotter outdoor air increases envelope heat gain.

cases.name: door_infiltration_duration
cases.requirement: Longer/higher door opening category increases hot-air gain.

cases.name: ventilation_co2_thermal_tradeoff
cases.requirement: Ventilation lowers CO2 but imports heat in hot weather.

cases.name: solar_day_night
cases.requirement: Night solar is zero and daytime solar is positive.

cases.name: hvac_action_energy_ordering
cases.requirement: HIGH consumes at least MEDIUM, LOW, and OFF.

cases.name: hvac_inertia_and_gradual_temperature
cases.requirement: HVAC ramps toward command and temperature changes gradually.

cases.name: physical_bounds_stress_rollout
cases.requirement: State bounds and non-negative energy hold under 24h stress.

limitations: 2R1C uses one lumped zone capacitance and does not resolve individual wall layers.
Synthetic weather/events are validated in the next milestone.
Parameters are engineering approximations and are not calibrated to a real building.
The simulator is suitable for controlled RL experiments, not equipment sizing.
